result.subject: Update on EU Data Residency Options
result.body:
Hi CTO,

I hope you’re well. I wanted to touch base on the EU data residency options we discussed, which were outlined after the Board meeting. Could you share a quick status update and let me know a realistic target date for completion? If there are any obstacles, I’m happy to help unblock them. I’d like to provide the CEO with an update before the next Board meeting on Nov 26.

Thanks,
Business Operations
